sprint: Magic Card Art — Enlarged Card View on Every Screen
task: Direct follow-up to a resolved-as-by-design report: a screenshot showing the Magic Card back face's small Guardian panel reading 'LUMO' confused the user ('my card is showing lumo where as i got inkquill as my companion') -- confirmed via two live Playwright rendering tests, not a bug: Companion Canon V2 always shows the bonded companion (Quill) on the FRONT face's own headline and Lumo (the fixed, never-bonded 'Guardian of Story Companions') in the small Guardian panel on BOTH faces, exactly matching the screenshot and the codebase's documented design. Confirmed, then a new request followed: 'i want to increase the size of card view on all screens where each element is easily readable.' Investigation found .magic-card-art-canvas's enlarged clamp(150px,32vw,240px) sizing (from an earlier 'Star Traveller screen' sprint) was scoped ONLY to the ceremony's First Claimed Moment via an ancestor-dependent selector (.magic-card-awaken-stage .magic-card-art-view .magic-card-art-canvas) -- Magic Card Home's 'View My Card' and the nickname-prompt preview both stayed stuck at a flat 150px, one because its wrapper never carried the required .magic-card-art-view class, the other because its ancestor (.magic-card-home-panel) was never .magic-card-awaken-stage. Generalized the enlarged clamp() onto the bare base rule instead, so every screen gets it with zero dependency on wrapper/ancestor structure. This alone wasn't enough: a live Playwright measurement showed Home's canvases collapsing to a 90px floor, not growing -- _fitAwakenStageToAvailableSpace()'s width-shrink escalation (tuned for a smooth, single-line-height response) overshot when the bigger 240px pair crossed Home's own panel wrap threshold, since un-wrapping from 2 stacked lines to 1 drops a whole line's height at once, a discontinuity the linear deficit*1.4 heuristic doesn't model. Root-caused (not patched around) by widening the room instead: .magic-card-home-panel's own max-width bumped 460px->600px, plus a second, deeper layering bug found via direct computed-style inspection -- that inner panel's width:100% was itself capped by its OWN parent, #magicCardContent (.magic-card-panel), whose base rule flat-caps every mode at 520px with no home-mode override at all (unlike gate-mode's existing 680px override) -- fixed by adding the missing .magic-card-overlay.magic-card-mode-home .magic-card-panel{max-width:600px} override, mirroring the gate-mode pattern exactly. Verified via a new Playwright suite driving the real UI (openHome() directly for Home; the real Awakening ceremony -- reveal, Claim It, nickname prompt, ceremony beats, First Claimed Moment -- for the other two) across 5 viewport sizes (1280x900 down to 420x700): all three screens now render genuine 240x336 canvases at typical sizes with zero scroll/overflow anywhere, and the shrink-to-fit safety net still gracefully engages at short viewports (240->143->90 as height drops) without ever reintroducing a scrollbar. Screenshots confirm both Home's reveal-gated Back face (still correctly blurred behind Tap to Reveal) and the nickname-preview's dramatically more legible Front/Back pair. Full regression: both goldenBuild.js suites pass unchanged (this touches only root Studio CSS); 3 pre-existing scratch-script failures (Creation Flow Screen-1 locator timeouts predating the Traveller Gateway's own skip-helper convention) confirmed via git stash to fail identically on the unmodified baseline, unrelated to this change. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to css/style.css.
